description: Reformat a legal motion draft to comply with California Superior Court filing rules (CRC Rule 2.108). Open /home/ga/Documents/motion_draft.docx which contains a Motion to Compel Discovery. The current draft has incorrect formatting (Calibri 11pt, single spacing, standard margins). You must apply the following specific changes: (1) Change all body text font to Times New Roman, 12 points; (2) Set line spacing to Double for the entire document; (3) Set the Left Margin to 1.5 inches (to accommodate line numbers) while keeping Top, Bottom, and Right margins at 1.0 inch; (4) Enable continuous Line Numbering for the document; (5) Add page numbers centered in the footer; (6) Apply 'Heading 1' style to the major section headings (MEMORANDUM, STATEMENT OF FACTS, ARGUMENT, CONCLUSION, DECLARATION). Save the compliant document as a new file at /home/ga/Documents/motion_formatted.docx. Do not overwrite the original draft.
